name: eshi-tech-notes
description: 饿师傅的技术札记 — a Tianyi-blue geek personal blog built with Vue 3, Node.js and SQLite.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,blue "pnpm --filter @eshi/server run dev" "pnpm --filter @eshi/client run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @eshi/client run build && pnpm --filter @eshi/server run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check:no-comments && pnpm run build
